择.hint: 扌 (hand) gives the meaning: to pick out by hand. The right side is a short form of 睪 (yì), once the sound part (擇 → 择). 译 has the same right side.

段.hint: A hand with a chisel (殳) cutting stone from a cliff (the left side): a piece, a section.

而.hint: An old drawing of a beard: the top line is the chin, the strokes below are hairs. Borrowed as a word: and, but (而且, 然而).

燕.hint: A swallow, with its head 廿, wings 北, and tail 灬

王.hint: A man 十 bridging heaven and earth (both 一)

广.hint: A lean-to 厂, suggesting a building

滩.hint: Difficult 难 waters 氵 to navigate; 难 also provides the pronunciation

夜.hint: A person 亻 sneaking by under cover 亠 of night 夕

形.hint: Sunlight 彡 streaming through a window 开

讨.hint: To ask 讠 for something 寸

论.hint: Speech 讠 that explains the logic 仑; 仑 also provides the pronunciation
